ranges.name: UNINDEXED_SPRITE_TILE_DATA

ranges.name: ROM_PADDING_ZERO_001A830A
ranges.boundary: Every byte is zero; the range follows the level12.map RNC block and precedes the graphics band at 0x001A8320.

ranges.name: UNCOMPRESSED_GRAPHICS_BAND_001A8320
ranges.boundary: Begins at the first Ghidra-defined graphics fragment after level12.map and ends immediately before Game_InitializeAndEnterFrameLoop at 0x001A8A4A.

evidence: The 0x0011E160 band is exactly 117 32-byte tile records with Genesis 4bpp pixel-pattern bytes.
The 0x001A830A-0x001A831F gap is byte-uniform zero padding.
The 0x001A8320-0x001A8A49 band contains repeated Genesis 4bpp graphics patterns and is bounded by the known initializer code entry.
qualification: The graphics names are intentionally neutral because no narrower asset manifest or runtime consumer has been recovered.
